title: 我想了个后备方案  (I Thought Up a Backup Plan)

segments.t: Out in the corridor, Bu Xiaogu pitches a smart backup plan to Chun Yuqiao: if sought-after idol Yin Zhengyu falls through, invite his beloved younger brother Yin Jiaxi instead. Listen first.
我有点担心。
担心什么？
尹正宇现在太热门，工作邀约特别多。
所以我想了个后备方案，不知道可不可行。
继续。
尹正宇的亲弟弟尹家希，他哥哥特别疼他。
尹家希出道两年了，现在特别火。
我知道了，不错。
老大认可了，我立马就去执行！
Now let's walk through the corridor pitch step by step.
我有点担心。
'I am a little worried.' Pairing "youdian", 'a little bit', with "danxin", literally 'carry one's heart', is a polite, measured way to flag a risk to your boss.
担心什么？
'Worried about what?' Mandarin keeps question words right where the answer belongs, so "shenme", 'what', follows "danxin" instead of jumping to the front.
尹正宇现在太热门，工作邀约特别多。
'Yin Zhengyu is too sought-after right now, and he has tons of work offers.' Calling a star "remen", literally 'hot door', means in high demand, and "tebie duo" says 'especially many'.
所以我想了个后备方案，不知道可不可行。
'So I thought up a backup plan; I do not know whether it is workable.' Notice how "kexing", 'feasible', splits into "ke bu kexing" to ask 'feasible or not?' right after "bu zhidao", 'I do not know'.
继续。
'Go on.' Crisp two-syllable "jixu" means 'continue' — all a busy producer needs to say to keep a good pitch moving.
尹正宇的亲弟弟尹家希，他哥哥特别疼他。

'Yin Zhengyu's own younger brother Yin Jiaxi — his older brother dotes on him.' Normally, "teng" means 'ache', so saying an older brother "gege" 'aches for' his younger brother "didi" warmly means he dotes on him.
尹家希出道两年了，现在特别火。
'Yin Jiaxi debuted two years ago, and right now he is really popular.' Showbiz term "chudao" means make one's debut, and calling someone "huo", literally 'fire', means red-hot popular.
我知道了，不错。
'Got it — not bad.' Understated Chinese praise loves "bucuo", literally 'not wrong' — coming from stern Chun Yuqiao, "bucuo" is practically a standing ovation.
老大认可了，我立马就去执行！

'The boss approved it — I will go carry it out right away!' Staff affectionately call their chief "laoda", 'big boss', and energetic "lima" means 'on the spot, immediately'. Now listen to Xiaogu's whole backup-plan pitch again.
我有点担心。
担心什么？
尹正宇现在太热门，工作邀约特别多。
所以我想了个后备方案，不知道可不可行。
继续。
尹正宇的亲弟弟尹家希，他哥哥特别疼他。
尹家希出道两年了，现在特别火。
我知道了，不错。
老大认可了，我立马就去执行！
For the first time, Chun Yuqiao gives Xiaogu's idea a nod of approval. Next, Wang Er hands her the contacts to execute it herself. You heard "danxin", "jixu", and high praise "bucuo".
回头见！
